mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study (user_id, post_id, title, location, max_member, deadline, state, tech_stacks, category, created_at, delete_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{title}, #{location}, #{maxMember}, #{deadline}, #{state}, #{techStacks}, #{category}, now(), NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.post_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.location, s.max_member, s.state, s.tech_stacks AS techStacks, s.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_member_count FROM study s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.delete_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id, s.post_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.location, s.max_member, s.state, s.tech_stacks AS techStacks, s.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_member_count FROM study s WHERE s.post_id = #{id} AND s.delete_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id, s.post_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.location, s.max_member, s.state, s.tech_stacks AS techStacks, s.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_member_count FROM study s WHERE s.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id, s.post_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.location, s.max_member, s.state, s.tech_stacks AS techStacks, s.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_member_count FROM study s WHERE s.delete_at IS NULL AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE delete_at IS NULL AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT user_id FROM study_participant WHERE study_id = #{studyId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE study SET state = 'CLOSED', modified_at = now() WHERE state = 'RECRUITING' AND deadline < now() AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM study WHERE state = 'RECRUITING' AND deadline < now() AND delete_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM study WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.post_id AS postId, s.user_id AS userId, s.title, s.location, s.max_member AS maxMember, s.state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS currentMemberCount FROM study s JOIN study_participant sp ON s.id = sp.study_id WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.post_id AS postId, s.user_id AS userId, s.title, s.location, s.max_member AS maxMember, s.state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS currentMemberCount FROM study s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.post_id AS postId, s.user_id AS userId, s.title, s.location, s.max_member AS maxMember, s.state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_participant sp WHERE sp.study_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'APPROVED') AS currentMemberCount FROM study s JOIN bookmark b ON s.post_id = b.post_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND s.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
